repos.description: little-canary is a prompt-injection detector that reads attacks by their effect on a sacrificial canary model before they reach production. Puts a small canary model in front of your app, watches whether untrusted input compromises it, and returns block, flag, or pass as an inbound preflight check before your primary model acts.
